Alternate way to join

Twilio won’t send the link?

Click Open Your Video Call and enter the customer’s CID on that page to open your side of the call.

Open Your Video Call ↗
Tell the customer how to join

Ask the customer to go to nowams.com. Once they are on the page, give them their CID and tell them to enter it and click Join Call.
